defects.evidence: “Responsible for” does not show what you accomplished.
Avoid “single-handedly,” “entire,” and “every team” unless you can prove and explain them in an interview.
These two bullets communicate essentially the same accomplishment
It communicates no action, scope, or result and weakens the otherwise technical project.
“I worked on” is conversational and indirect.
Put experience in reverse chronological order
“Builds” is present tense for a past role.
